share: Share the machine. One job per PC button press. Oldest open job first. Prefer a claim that is not already waiting on another open job. Not a hard ceiling — you may post more than one. Refuse 9000x parallel, 10-wide, tensor scrapes, titan/dc mmap storms, inject 0x01, pulse 78, light 7913. HTTP is not the computer. CUT ports stay on 127.0.0.1. White Box fabrication is one-and-done; this board does not start :7862.
